reviews.title: Cost effective, top quality, best Cooling. Recommended.
reviews.comment: The thermalright Phantom Spirit 120 is massive, good quality, very easy to install and the fans are silent. The thermal paste included was a dry, as mentioned by some purchaser. However, it gets the job done, my temps don't exceed over 50 Degrees Celsius. It is well packaged and secured. Im really happy with thermalright, totally recommend it.
reviews.author: KheertikJ

reviews.title: Amazing Heatsink for the Price
reviews.comment: Great heatsink for the price. Keeps my 5950x around 50c and after a long work session never goes above 70c. Ran some stress tests while working out my PBO settings and never got above the thermal limit and found out I run into VRM issues before I get a Proc_Hot thermal throttle. Installation could be better, but for the price it's fine. You might struggle to get the screws set to the frame but it does work. Fans are fine and they aren't loud at 1500rpm. Looks great in the case for an all black build. I have 2 sticks of G. SKILL Ripjaws V and you get maybe 1mm of clearance under the fan. Tried to show this in the photos the ram clearance. I can see this lasting a quite a few upgrades and years of service. Happened to be doing some pc maintenance so thought I would give this little beast and Thermalright a shout out.
reviews.author: Amrit Ramjattan

reviews.title: Amazing at any price, but it is so cheap buy one now
reviews.comment: It’s an amazing value, fans are quiet, CPU stays at 30 C. The only issue I had was the thermal paste that came with was too thick, but it was the first time in a long time that I installed a cooler and I would chalk it up more to my incompetence than to what it came with. Outside of the thermal paste installation was very easy much easier than the cooler that I had inherited for this build. Highly recommend and would buy again for another machine.
